anti_overfit_boundary: Frozen N2 coefficients are not changed after any W0-W4 scores are observed.
No world, seed, race, legacy comparator, threshold or metric may be removed after scoring.
No real/historical data, odds, RESULT/PAYOUT, ROI, bankroll or economics inputs.
A pass is synthetic engineering evidence only; a fail may motivate a separately preregistered robust-combination experiment but no in-place rescue.

broad_robust_pass: On both seeds, N2 mean KL on W0, W1 and W2 must be <= the best legacy C0/C1/N1 mean KL for that world.
On both seeds, N2 mean KL on W3 and W4 must be <= 1.05x the best legacy C0/C1/N1 mean KL for that world.
On both seeds, N2 equal-weight W0-W4 pooled mean KL must be <= 0.98x the best single legacy model equal-weight W0-W4 pooled mean KL.

purpose: Falsify frozen N2 against the full existing W0-W4 synthetic world suite after v8 showed it dominates C0 on W0/W2.
